note: Configuration only, read by core.port.sk. No scouting state lives here -- per-branch last-scouted SHAs and every candidate live in memory/semantic/generated/port_candidates.json. `remote` names an existing git remote; null means PORT_SCOUT fetches by URL into refs/port/<id>/* without adding a permanent remote. `licence` was checked against the GitHub API on 2026-09-19 and is a fact about the source, not a ruling on porting -- PORT_STUDY re-checks it per candidate. `enabled: false` sources are known and listed but not scouted until switched on.

sources.name: OptiScaler (cdozdil, upstream)
sources.why: Where the D3D11-on-D3D12 bridge, hooks, FSR/XeSS backends, FG and spoofing come from. Most new work here is unrelated to DLSS-NR; the value is compatibility fixes and new game/driver workarounds that land in files we share.

sources.name: wilsjo2/OptiScaler-DLSSNR-PreSR-Multipass (parent fork)
sources.why: Our direct parent and the most active DLSS-NR line. His codex/* topic branches and v0.8.x tags carry features that are not in our main (release-v0.8.4, native-rr-controls, per-pass-strengths, padded-presr-input, ...). Also where our own PRs land, so PORT_SCOUT must tell 'ours, ported back' from 'new'.

sources.name: Dagherbou/OptiScaler_DLSSNR (DLSS-NR origin)
sources.why: Where the DLSS-NR integration started (see docs/CREDITS.md). Not a live remote here. Switch on to trace where a behaviour originated or to check whether a fix reached the original author's line.

sources.name: sdli1995/dlssg_for_sm86 (optional RTX 20/30 MFG bundle)
sources.why: Packaging dependency only (package_release.ps1 -IncludeAmpereMfg, pinned in .github/workflows/package_release.yml). The repo declares no licence, so no code may be ported from it -- scout it only to decide when to bump the pinned SHA.
